newsitem.title: USA: Ex-NY inmate sues jailer over sagging breast.
newsitem.headline: Ex-NY inmate sues jailer over sagging breast.

text.p: A former inmate is suing her jailer for $3 million claiming she was refused proper medical care for a sagging breast implant, authorities said Thursday.
Maryanne Sadelmyer, 34, contends that officials at the Schenectady County, New York jail never heard her complaints that her right breast implant was defective during her 1992 imprisonment.
She is seeking damages for indignities and pain in a May 13 trial before U.S. Magistrate Ralph W. Smith Jr. in Albany..
In her lawsuit, Sadelmyer said that when she told the jail's medical staff that one of her reconstructed breasts began to hurt and fall apart she was accused of faking her pain.
All defendants in the case, including the county sheriff, have denied any wrongdoing in the case.
"I am surprised this suit hasn't been dismissed, but she is a very smart woman," said Sheriff William Barnes.
Court records show Sadelmyer's implant was removed in March 1994 when she was serving time at a state prison.
